name: List All Community Association Renters
description: Returns Community Association (CA) renters that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[Id]
queryFilters.description: Filter by unique identifier of the CA renter. All GET requests must include a filter for [Id], [AssociationId] or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: filters[AssociationId]
queryFilters.description: Filter by unique identifier of the Community Association. All GET requests must include a filter for [Id], [AssociationId] or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter CA renters by last updated date. All GET requests must include a filter for [Id], [AssociationId] or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the CA renter

responseFields.name: data[].AssociationId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the association related to the CA renter

responseFields.name: data[].Email
responseFields.description: The CA renter's primary email address

responseFields.name: data[].FirstName
responseFields.description: The first name of the CA renter

responseFields.name: data[].LastName
responseFields.description: The last name of the CA renter

responseFields.name: data[].PhoneNumber
responseFields.description: The CA renter's primary phone number

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: Returns the CA renters records that have been updated since the date provided. The default time zone is Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

responseFields.name: data[].LeaseEndDate
responseFields.description: The date the CA renter's lease ends

responseFields.name: data[].LeaseStartDate
responseFields.description: The date the CA renter's lease starts

responseFields.name: data[].UnitId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the unit related to the CA renter

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
